title: Make Fly-Through Videos for Your Listings
summary: Give each listing a 3D map fly-through and stills of the area with labelled pins, then cut short clips with a title and thumbnail for your posts.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you would otherwise pay for location videos; the value is cost saved per listing.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer paid location videos for each listing.
Listings that show the area, not just the house.
who_its_for: Short-term rental hosts and home builders.

stack.name: Google Earth
stack.role: Makes 3D map stills and fly-through videos with labelled pins and Google Earth files.
stack.creator: sia14u

stack.name: Video Editor
stack.role: Adds titles, thumbnails and short cuts for each channel.

steps.name: Video Editor
steps.does: Adds a title, thumbnail and short cuts

outputs: Stills and short clips for posts

steps: Pick the listing and the nearby places to show.
Cut short clips with a title and post them.
guardrails: Check each pin and label before you publish.
Follow Google's terms for map imagery and attribution.
